fact: A procurement notice issued 4 December 2023 asks a firm to design and implement the e-GP system within 52 weeks and then operate, support and maintain it for three years.
title: Specific Procurement Notice: Design, Development/Customization, Supply, Installation and Maintenance of an Electronic Government Procurement (e-GP) System in Sierra Leone
publisher: Government of Sierra Leone, Accountable Governance for Basic Service Delivery Project
